info.title: reseek
info.description: A Soulseek client daemon: its configuration, transfers, searches, chat and shares.

post.summary:
Where the provider ends sessions it started, with a signed logout token naming its session
or its user. Always answered 200.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the provider's name in the configuration

get.summary:
Where the provider sends the browser back to: checks the login, signs the user in with a
session cookie and returns them to the page they came from.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the provider's name in the configuration

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: the authorization code to exchange, null when the provider sent an error

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: the value sent with the login, matched against the login cookie

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: the provider's error code when it refused the login

parameters.name: error_description
parameters.description: the provider's explanation of `error`, shown on the login page as text

302.description: signed in, or to the login page with the provider's error

403.description: the account is not let in

get.summary: Sends the browser to the provider's login, remembering the login in a sealed cookie.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the provider's name in the configuration

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description:
the path on this site to return to after the login, `/` when left out; anything that is
not a path on this site is refused

post.summary: Reads a provider's discovery document now and reports what it names.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the provider's name in the configuration

get.summary:
The event stream: `hello`, a snapshot of each topic that has one, then every frame of the
topics as it happens. A client reconnecting with `Last-Event-ID` gets what it missed when it
is still kept, else fresh snapshots and `lagged`.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description:
the topics to follow, comma-separated: `application`, `logs`, `metrics`, `search`,
`search:<id>`, `transfers`, `conversations`, `rooms`, `users`, `events`; `application`
when left out

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description:
an API token or a configuration API key, for clients that can not set an
`Authorization` header; never a session cookie's value

patch.summary:
Sets and removes runtime overrides. They last across restarts until they expire, are
removed, or the files change the value under them.

get.summary: A configuration file's text, secrets and all.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description:
the file's name, such as `config.d/10-shares.toml`; the first configuration file when
not given

put.summary: Replaces the whole text of a configuration file, then reloads.

patch.summary: Changes some keys of a configuration file, keeping its comments, then reloads.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description:
the file's name, such as `config.d/10-shares.toml`; the first configuration file when
not given

post.summary: Whether a text would load as a configuration file, checked with every other layer.

delete.summary: Removes the runtime override of one key.

get.summary: The options the daemon started with, which every restart-class option still runs with.
Every option with where its value came from, the files, the overrides and what is pending.
Who the caller is, with the browser session it came with.

post.summary: Signs in with a local account's username and password and sets the session cookie.

204.description: signed in; the session cookie is set

get.summary:
Whether there is authentication at all for the caller: false on a trusted network and when
authentication is off.

post.summary:
Ends the caller's browser session and clears its cookie. For a session from an OpenID
Connect provider that has a logout page, that page is returned for the browser to go to.

get.summary: The ways to sign in the login page offers the caller.
The active browser sessions: the caller's own, or everyone's for an administrator.

delete.summary: Revokes every active browser session but the caller's own.
Revokes one browser session, the caller's own or, for an administrator, anyone's.

get.summary:
The caller's tokens, or everyone's for an administrator, who also sees the configuration's
API keys. Revoked tokens are not listed.

post.summary:
Creates a token with at most the caller's own role. Its secret is in the answer and is
never shown again. Needs a login session: a token can not make tokens.

put.summary: Renames a token or changes its expiry; the owner's or, for an administrator, anyone's.

delete.summary:
Revokes a token; the owner's or, for an administrator, anyone's. The record is kept a month
for the audit view.

AnalysisCompleted.description: The data of a `files.analysis` frame: a report finished.

confidence.description: how sure the analyser is of its reading

transferId.description: the download the file belongs to, null when it was analysed by path

AnalysisFlag.description: A finding reported alongside the verdict, independent of the cutoff.

AnalysisMeasures.description:
The aggregate measures of a file. Each is null when the file had too little non-silent
audio to measure it or the measure does not apply to the file.

bitDepthEffective.description: the bits per sample actually in use, null for codecs without integer samples

clippedSamplesPct.description: the percentage of samples at full scale

cutoffHzHistogram.description: pairs of a cutoff in Hz and how many non-silent windows have it, ascending by cutoff

cutoffMedianHz.description: the median cutoff over the non-silent windows, in Hz

dcOffset.description: the mean sample value relative to full scale

frameArtefactScore.description: how strongly the noise floor repeats at lossy codec frame lengths, from 0 to 1

noiseFloorDbfs.description: the estimated noise floor in dBFS

sfb21Holes.description: the ratio of near-zero to populated bins between 16 and 20 kHz

shelfSharpnessDbP95.description: the 95th percentile of the energy drop across 500 Hz above the cutoff, in dB

sideEnergyDb.description: the energy of the side channel in dB, null for mono

stereoCorrelation.description: the correlation between the channels, null for mono

upsampleRatio.description:
the fraction of energy above half the claimed band, null unless the file claims more
than 48 kHz

AnalysisOverride.description: The user's judgement of a file, with who recorded it.

by.description: the subject of the principal that recorded it

note.description: why, in the user's words; null when none was given

AnalysisVerdict.description: The analyser's reading of whether the audio matches the format the file claims.

AnalysisWindow.description: The measures of one analysed window.

cutoffHz.description: the highest band within 60 dB of the window's peak, in Hz; null for a near-silent window

shelfDb.description: the energy drop across 500 Hz above the cutoff, in dB; null without a cutoff

t.description: where the window starts, in seconds from the start of the file

Apply.description: When a changed value takes effect.

AudioAnalysis.description: The analysis of one audio file.

confidence.description: how sure the analyser is of its reading, from 0 to 0.98

durationSeconds.description: how long the audio is, in seconds

oneOf.description: the encoder profile the cutoff matches, null when it matches none

flags.description: findings independent of the verdict, empty when there are none

limitations.description: what made this analysis less reliable, such as few windows or a decoder error

measures.description: the aggregate measures over the non-silent windows

oneOf.description: the user's judgement, shown in place of the verdict; null until the user sets one

size.description: the file's size in bytes when it was analysed

spectrogramUrl.description: where the spectrogram image of this report is served

summary.description: one sentence saying what the analyser found and where
summary.example: 68% of the time is full-band; 32% shows a 16 kHz cutoff concentrated in vocal content.

windows.description: the measures of each analysed window, null where the per-window list was left out

BackchannelLogout.description:
The form an identity provider posts to `POST /auth/oidc/{name}/backchannel` to end
sessions it started. The name is the OpenID Connect one.

logout_token.description: the signed logout token naming the provider session or the subject to sign out

createdAt.description: when the block was made, null for a block from the configuration

createdBy.description: the name of the principal that made the block, null for a block from the configuration

expiresAt.description: when the block ends on its own, null for never

scopes.description: what the block stops; every scope for a block from the configuration

BrowseProgress.description: How far the running browse of a user has received its reply.

bytesRemaining.description: bytes of the reply still to come

percentComplete.description: how much of the reply arrived, from 0 to 100

size.description: the size of the whole reply in bytes

ByeReason.description: Why the server closes a stream.

ChatUnread.description: Unread counts over every conversation and room, the data of a `chat.unread` frame.

rooms.description: unread messages and mentions, by room

total.description:
the conversations' unread messages plus the rooms' unread mentions; plain room messages
do not count

ClaimedFormat.description: The format a file's container claims.

bitDepth.description: bits per sample, null for codecs that have none such as MP3

bitrateKbps.description: the nominal bitrate in kbit/s, null for lossless codecs

CompletedMetrics.description: Transfers that finished since the daemon started.

bytes.description: the bytes moved by the ones that succeeded

failed.description: how many failed, cancelled ones included

ConfigApiKey.description: An API key from the configuration, listed read-only beside the tokens.

cidr.description: the networks the key is accepted from, comma-separated

name.description:
the key's name in the configuration, `primary` for the single key given by environment
variable or command line

role.description: what a request with the key may do

revision.description: a hash of its contents, null when the file does not exist

text.description: its text, null when the file does not exist

ConfigView.description:
The configuration in effect with, for every key, where its value came from and how it can
be changed.

files.description: the configuration files, in the order they apply

loadError.description: why the last reload failed, null once one succeeds

managedBy.description: the tool that manages the files, which are then read-only, such as `nixos`

overrides.description: the runtime overrides in effect, by key

pendingReconnect.description: keys that take effect on reconnect whose value changed since the last connection

pendingRestart.description:
keys that take effect on restart whose value differs from the one the daemon started
with

values.description: the values in effect, secrets shown as `*****`

warnings.description: keys, flags and variables that were ignored, each with where it was found

ConfigurationState.description: The outcome of the last configuration reload.

lastReloadAt.description: when that reload failed, null once a reload succeeds

lastReloadError.description:
why the last reload failed, null once a reload succeeds; the values from before stay in
effect

ConnectionWatchdogState.description: The loop that reconnects to the Soulseek server.

isAttemptingConnection.description: a connection attempt is waiting or running

isEnabled.description: the loop is active and keeps trying

nextAttemptAt.description: when the next attempt starts, null when none is scheduled

Conversation.description: A private conversation with one peer.

draft.description: the unsent text the UI saved for the conversation, empty when none

isActive.description: false once the conversation was closed; the next message either way opens it again

isServerNotice.description:
the conversation holds the server's own notices, which can not be answered and never
count as unread

messages.description: the newest messages, oldest first; null in lists and frames and unless asked for

ConversationMessage.description:
A private message was stored, inbound or sent, the data of a `conversations.message`
frame.

ConversationSummary.description: The state of our conversation with a user, as a user profile shows it.

ConversationUpdate.description:
A conversation was opened, acknowledged or closed, the data of a `conversations.update`
frame.

CreateToken.description: The body of `POST /tokens`. At most one of `expiresIn` and `expiresAt` is given.

cidr.description: the networks the token is accepted from, comma-separated; null for anywhere

expiresAt.description: when the token stops being accepted; null for no expiry unless `expiresIn` is given

expiresIn.description:
how long the token lasts from now, such as `"30d"`; null for no expiry unless
`expiresAt` is given

name.description: a name to tell the token apart by, 1 to 64 characters

role.description: what a request with the token may do, at most the creator's own role

CreatedToken.description: A token just created, with the secret that is shown this once and never again.

secret.description: the secret to send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`

allOf.description: the principal the request acts as

provider.description:
the provider the identity came from: `local`, `proxy` or an OpenID Connect provider's
name; null when there is no session

oneOf.description:
the browser session the request came with, null for an API token, a config API key or a
trusted network

CurrentPrincipal.description: Who the caller is, as `GET /session` returns it.

CurrentSession.description: The browser session a request came with.

expiresAt.description: when the session ends regardless of use

DirectionMetrics.description: Live transfer figures for one direction.

completed.description: transfers that finished since the daemon started

queued.description: transfers waiting in a queue, here or at the peer

DistributedNetworkState.description: Our place in the distributed search network.

branchLevel.description: our level in the tree, 0 at a branch root

branchRoot.description: the username at the root of our branch

childLimit.description: how many children we take at most

isBranchRoot.description: whether we are a branch root

localDirectoryName.description: the absolute local directory the files were moved into

remoteDirectoryName.description:
the remote directory, the remote filename without its last segment; empty for a file
without a directory

username.description: the user the directory came from

version.description: the shape version of this event type, 0

localFilename.description: the absolute path the file was moved to

remoteFilename.description: the remote filename as requested, with the peer's separators

version.description: the shape version of this event type, 0

localFilename.description: the incomplete file holding the bytes that arrived, null when no file was created

reason.description: the transfer's error: the peer's refusal, the timeout, the I/O or move error

remoteFilename.description: the remote filename as requested, with the peer's separators

version.description: the shape version of this event type, 0

EncoderGuess.description: An encoder profile the measured cutoff matches.

confidence.description: how sure the analyser is of the match, from 0 to 1

ErrorBody.description: What went wrong, sent with every 4xx and 5xx status.

detail.description: a longer explanation, null when the message says it all

error.description: a short message, or a fixed code such as `soulseek_unavailable`

oneOf.description: a download succeeded and its file was moved into the downloads directory

data.description: a download succeeded and its file was moved into the downloads directory

oneOf.description: the last pending download from a user in one remote directory succeeded

data.description: the last pending download from a user in one remote directory succeeded

oneOf.description: an upload succeeded

data.description: an upload succeeded

oneOf.description: a private message arrived, or the server delivered an unacknowledged one again

data.description: a private message arrived, or the server delivered an unacknowledged one again

oneOf.description: a message was said in a room we are in, our own included

data.description: a message was said in a room we are in, our own included

oneOf.description: a user was blocked

data.description: a user was blocked

oneOf.description: a user's block was removed or expired

oneOf.description: an API token was created

data.description: an API token was created

oneOf.description: an API token was revoked

data.description: an API token was revoked

oneOf.description: someone signed in and got a browser session

data.description: someone signed in and got a browser session

oneOf.description: a browser session ended before it expired, or expired

data.description: a browser session ended before it expired, or expired

oneOf.description: a sign-in was refused

data.description: a sign-in was refused

oneOf.description: an audio analysis the user asked for finished

oneOf.description: a download failed for good, or its file could not be moved into the downloads directory

oneOf.description: a script ran for an event; never delivered to scripts

data.description: a script ran for an event; never delivered to scripts

oneOf.description: the connection to the Soulseek server is up, before login

data.description: the connection to the Soulseek server is up, before login

oneOf.description: the connection to the Soulseek server was lost or closed

data.description: the connection to the Soulseek server was lost or closed

oneOf.description: a test event with no fields, for trying scripts

Event.description: An event's type with its data, written as `type` and a `data` object.

EventError.description: An error, as an event shows it.

type.description: the short name of the error's type

id.description: unique per event; consumers drop repeats by it

timestamp.description: when it happened, which for a finished transfer is when the transfer ended

EventRecord.description: One event as the event log keeps it.

EventType.description: What kind of event something is, written as its name and read ignoring case.

FieldView.description: One key: where its value came from and how it can be changed.

apply.description: when a change to the value takes effect

cliFlag.description: the long command-line flag that sets the key

envVar.description: the environment variable that sets the key

file.description: the file a save of the key writes: the last file that sets it, else the first file

kind.description: what kind of value the key holds

oneOf.description: the files' value when it is not the one in effect, and why

secret.description: whether the value is shown as `*****`

source.description: the layer whose value is in effect

File.description:
A file a peer shares, as a search response, a browse or a folder listing carries it. The
named attribute fields are taken from `attributes`.

attributeCount.description: how many attributes the peer sent, unknown types included

attributes.description: the attributes in the order the peer sent them

bitDepth.description: bits per sample, null when the peer did not say

bitRate.description: kbit/s, null when the peer did not say

code.description: the code byte the peer sent, 1 in practice

extension.description: the extension as the peer sent it, often empty

filename.description:
the full remote path in a search response, the bare name in a browse or folder listing,
with the peer's separators kept exactly

isLocked.description: the file is in a locked list

isVariableBitRate.description: whether the bit rate varies, null when the peer did not say

length.description: the duration in whole seconds, null when the peer did not say

sampleRate.description: Hz, null when the peer did not say

oneOf.description:
the size does not fit the duration and the declared format; null when it fits, when
there is too little to tell, and outside search responses

version.description: the shape version of this event type, 0

FileAnalysisComplete.description: The data of `FileAnalysisComplete`: the report without its per-window measures.

FileAttribute.description: One typed value of a shared file, such as its bit rate or duration.

value.description: the value, in the type's unit

FileAttributeType.description: the attribute type's name, or its number when the type is not known

FilePatch.description: Changes some keys of a configuration file, keeping its comments.

file.description: the file to change, the first configuration file when null

revision.description: the file's revision the change was made against, null when the file did not exist

set.description: the keys to write and their values; `*****` for a secret keeps it, `""` clears it

unset.description: the keys to take out of the file

FileReplace.description: Replaces the whole text of a configuration file.

file.description: the file to replace, the first configuration file when null

revision.description: the file's revision the text was written against, null when the file did not exist

FileValidate.description: A text to check as the new contents of a configuration file.

file.description: the file it would replace, the first configuration file when null

name.description: as the files are named, such as `config.toml` or `config.d/10-shares.toml`

readOnlyReason.description: why the file can not be written

revision.description: a hash of its contents, null when the file does not exist

writable.description: whether a save to the file can be made

allOf.description: what the reload after the write changed

FileWritten.description: What a write to a configuration file did.

GapReason.description: Why reseek missed a room's messages for a while.

GroupSource.description: Where the effective group of a user comes from.

search.description: how incoming searches are being answered

Hello.description: The first frame of every stream.

resumed.description: whether the frames missed since `Last-Event-ID` follow instead of fresh snapshots

serverTime.description: the server's clock when the stream opened

topics.description: the topics the stream carries, in the order asked for

version.description: the running version

HistoryGap.description:
An interval with no room history because reseek was not there to receive messages. The
data of a `rooms.gap` frame, which is sent once logged in again.

to.description: when it received again, null while it is still disconnected

averageSpeed.description: the moving average of their mean speed, in bytes per second

totalSpeed.description: the moving average of their summed speed, in bytes per second

users.description: how many distinct users they are with

IncomingSearchHealth.description: How incoming search requests are being answered.

dropRate.description: how many were dropped in the current window

latency.description: the moving average time to answer one, in milliseconds

queueDepth.description: how many are waiting to be answered

JoinedRoom.description: A room we are in, as `GET /rooms/joined` lists it and `rooms.list` frames carry it.

lastMessageAt.description: when the latest stored message arrived, null when none is stored

mentions.description: those of them that mention us

unread.description: messages after the read marker, not ours and not hidden

userCount.description: who is in the room now

Judgement.description: The user's own judgement of a file.

KnownUser.description: What the known-users directory holds about a user, shared by the summary and the profile.

oneOf.description: our block of the user, or the configuration's; null when not blocked
our private conversation with the user, null when there is none

countryCode.description: the user's country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from a room member list; null when never seen

oneOf.description: the user's address from the endpoint cache, null when not cached; never a round trip

firstSeenAt.description: when we first interacted with the user, null when not known

group.description: the upload group the user is in

isPrivileged.description: the server last reported the user as privileged

known.description:
the directory has a row for the user; when false every stored field is null, zero or
empty

lastSeenAt.description: when we last interacted with the user, null when not known

muted.description: chat notifications for the user are off

oneOf.description: the last presence observed, null when never observed

presenceAt.description: when `presence` was observed, null when never

oneOf.description: the last statistics fetched, null when never

tags.description: our labels for the user, lower case

Lagged.description: The data of a `lagged` frame, an empty object.

oneOf.description: a token created through the API

allOf.description: a key from the configuration, which the API can not change

LiveFrame.description:
One frame of the event stream. Frames are named `<topic>.<event>`; the control frames
`hello`, `lagged` and `bye` belong to no topic and are always sent.

LocalProvider.description: Password login with a local account.

enabled.description: password login is on and allowed from the caller's address

LogLevel.description: How severe a log record is.

context.description: the module that logged it, such as `reseek::http`

message.description: the message with its fields, and the chain of error messages when an error is attached

subContext.description: what the module logged it for, such as a share host or a relay agent, when it says

ip.description: the client address the attempt came from

provider.description: `local` for a password login, else the OpenID Connect provider's configured name

reason.description: why it was refused, without the credentials presented

version.description: the shape version of this event type, 0

LoginRequest.description: A local account's username and password, the body of `POST /session`.

LogoutResponse.description: What a logout did, as `POST /session/logout` returns it.

redirect.description:
the identity provider's logout page for the browser to go to, null when the session was
not from an OpenID Connect provider that offers one

MessageCounts.description: Counts of our private messages with a user.

unread.description: from the user and not acknowledged

MessageDirection.description: Which way a private message went.

NoFields.description: The data of an event that has no fields of its own.

version.description: the shape version of this event type, 0

NotApplied.description: A value the files hold that is not the one in effect, because a reload with it failed.

reason.description: why it is not in effect

value.description: the value the failed reload read, `*****` for a secret

NotifyLevel.description: Which messages of a room or conversation notify.

OidcEndpoints.description: The endpoints an OpenID Connect discovery document lists.

authorization.description: where the browser is sent to sign in

endSession.description: where the browser is sent to sign out of the provider, null when the provider has none

jwks.description: where the provider's signing keys are published

token.description: where the authorization code is exchanged

userinfo.description: where claims missing from the ID token are fetched, null when the provider has none

OidcProvider.description: One OpenID Connect provider's login button.

autoLogin.description: the login page goes straight to this provider without showing itself

loginUrl.description: where the button leads to start the login

The outcome of reading a configured OpenID Connect provider's discovery document, as

oneOf.description: the endpoints the discovery document lists, null when it could not be read

error.description: why the test failed, null when it passed

issuer.description: the issuer the discovery document names, null when it could not be read

ok.description: the discovery document was read and names the configured issuer

key.description: the key the problem is about, null when it is about the whole text

oneOf.description: `true` or `false`
a whole number
a number with a fraction
text
a human-readable duration such as `"15m"`
